components.text:
A warning: Krystal went back to five days partly because the extra rest did not lift output by the 20% it needed.
So we cannot just ask people to push harder. Meetings and process go first.

notes: This is the plain arithmetic behind the whole decision. We work 40 hours a week today. Cut to 32 with the same total output, and every hour has to produce 25% more. Better rest alone will not close a gap that size. Krystal's support team is the example: the company said the extra recovery time did not raise output by the 20% it needed, the work became more stressful, and it went back to five days. So the process changes on the next page are not a nice extra. They decide whether the trial can work at all.
